fixes.explanation: Honor is a kind word, friend, but it isn't what Peter says. He asks Sapphira, "How could you agree to test the Spirit of the Lord?" (Acts 5:9). She came in unaware of what had happened to her husband, and Peter asked her if the price was what she and Ananias got for the land (Acts 5:7-8). She answered "Yes… that is the price," and that is where the word test comes in. I think this one is heavy, so it's worth slowing down on.

Follow is a good word, baker, but it isn't the one Peter uses. He asks, "How could you agree to test the Spirit of the Lord?" (Acts 5:9). Peter has just asked whether the price she gave was what she and her husband got for the land, and she said yes (Acts 5:8). The text says Ananias had kept back some of the proceeds with his wife's full knowledge (Acts 5:2). So "agree" points to the two of them going along together, and the word he lands on is test.
